about: A lock is mostly settled. Of the claims standing on this tree, the form of most leaves them one legal state: they are applied, and nothing about them is open.

What the form leaves with more than one state splits again: a reading closes some, some stand in force with nothing yet read against them, and a few say of themselves that they are decisions and are the only ones open.
The four classes are a partition: every claim is in exactly one, and their sizes fall in that order, most settled first.

cases.name: this tree, at the epoch it was read
